page.overview:
What is Libellus Sanguinis 3: Wolves at the Door?

Libellus Sanguinis: Wolves at the Door is the third in a series of sourcebooks that details the clans of Vampire: The Dark Ages. Volume III covers the Assamites, Gangrel, and Followers of Set.

Written by Jason Langlois. Details on the Gangrel all across Europe, including their population among the heathens in the East and North, their pre-christian beliefs, oral histories, and traditions.

Written by Clayton Oliver. Details about the Assamites, their internal structure and factions, the Caste system of the Clan, its interaction with outsiders, and its history since their Antediluvian left to found Alamut.

Written by Michael B. Lee. Details about the Setites, their faith about Set, and the holy mission of their Clan, the internal structure and schisms of the Clan in the Dark Medieval.
